morphology.compounding_rule: place-names Slavic (Bel-gorod white-town, Chorn-reka black-river); the Norse elite name halls and trade-forts (Holm-gard, Ulf-by) and ruling lineages (-ungar).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Slavic commons use -ov/-ich; the Norse ruling elite use -son/-dottir and the aett (ruling house); place-names are Slavic, the ruling lineage Norse.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: burned gards, abandoned kapishcha and barrow-kurgans: 'the Howe of [konungr]', 'the dead Gard of [name]'
patterns.military_units: the Norse hird (the prince's guard) and the Slavic druzhina: 'the Konungr's Hird', 'the Wolf-Druzhina'
patterns.ships: Norse river-longships (the elite's drakkar) with Slavic river-names: 'the Wave-Wolf', 'Storm-Raven', 'the Reka-Serpent'
patterns.taverns: the jarl's hall and the village honey-house: 'the Mead-Hall of [jarl]', 'the Honey-Cup'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon, STRATIFIED BY CLASS: the Norse warrior/ruling elite venerate the martial and sovereign powers by their NORSE names (from family_germanic norse reflexes); the Slavic farming/crafting commons venerate the earth, mother, hearth and ancestor powers by their SLAVIC names (from family_slavic theonym_set). Same shared pantheon, two registers. Never real Norse/Slavic gods. Rovan seeds/shifts across all three alignments; the worship/demonize set follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment), within each class's register.

class_register.norse_elite: the martial and sovereign powers: Eitnir (All-Father), Orlund (the jarls' war-oath), Nymir (the storm-sky wisdom, the ruler's power), Thulr (the king's sun-justice); sworn in the jarl's hall and at the hof
class_register.slavic_commons: the earth, mother, hearth and ancestor powers: Goyan (the earth/black soil), Relata (the mother and hearth), Tulor (the harvest-sun), and the Dedy (ancestral dead); kept at the kapishche-grove and the hearth

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set take dread epithets: Maraxus -> Marhr the War-Fire (Slav. Marakh); Vacidus -> Vakr the Unmaker (Slav. Vakid); Lusanto -> Lusandr the Hoard-Worm (Slav. Lusan).

holy_symbol_motifs.Goyan: the black earth beneath the plough (the commons)
holy_symbol_motifs.Nymir: a storm-eye between two ravens (the rulers)
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlund: crossed spears over an oath-ring (the jarls)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Hof (Norse temple, in the jarl-towns) and the Kapishche (Slavic idol-grove, in the villages): 'the Hof of Orlund', 'the Kapishche of Goyan'.
religion.saints_pattern: the elite honor the howe-dwelling ancestors of the ruling aett; the commons the Dedy (ancestral dead) at the kurgan; great Konungs become storm-riders.

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Goyan (Slavic; the black earth, the farmers' power; commons power)
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Nymir (Norse; the storm-sky wisdom, the ruler's power; elite power)
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Orlund (Norse; the jarls' iron-oath and war; elite power)
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Relata (Slavic; the mother and the hearth; commons power)

religion.the_one: Eitnir (Norse, the elite's far All-Father) / Oterun (Slavic, the commons' Heaven-Father) - the One under two registers

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (the elite the war-fire Marhr and the wolf-powers; the commons the wild Vakid), demonize the Lawful powers and the One
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Eitnir/Oterun) and the Lawful powers (elite: Thulr, Orlund, Nymir; commons: Goyan, Relata, Tulor), demonize the Chaotic powers
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent; the commons foreground the Dedy (ancestral dead) and the land-spirits, the elite the hall-ancestors (the aett-dead)

titles._tiers_note: Stratified, ascending: the lower tiers are the SLAVIC native nobility, the upper tiers the NORSE ruling elite. Boyarin (Slavic land-lord) barony; Posadnik (Slavic town-governor) march; Voevoda (Slavic war-governor) county; Jarl (Norse earl) duchy; Konungr (Norse king, styled Knyaz to the commons) principality; Storkonungr (great-king, styled Velikii Knyaz / grand prince) kingdom; Yfirkonungr (over-king, the early Rus style Kagan) over the realm. The Norse elite rule; the Slavic boyars and the veche administer the land. (Rank titles are the real Norse/Slavic register, allowed.)
titles.government: feudal (the Rus: a Norse ruling elite over a Slavic populace - Konungr-princes and their jarls over the native boyars and voevodas; river-trade principalities)
